card.fires_on: Characters inside the random 11-character video ID after youtube.com/watch?v= in web links. Also fires once on the 'ol' ending of mOsmol before /kg.

modes.label: YouTube video ID

modes.label: Unit ending
modes.description: The 'ol' ending of mOsmol just before a slash and kg in a lab unit.

card.writes: It promotes odd dash and full-width symbols and suppresses slash, plus and other symbols, so it mostly adds no clear content.
card.plain: It lights up on the jumbled random letters inside a YouTube link, where the next character is unpredictable.
